sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: This day your energy levels are likely to be below par. You may tend to be restless, inactive, and averse to exerting yourself in any way. Routine tasks, even the important ones could remain unattended. But, says Ganesha, you will try to pull yourself together later in the day, make amends by trying to do something meaningful. Towards this end, success will smile upon you.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: Today may be one of those days in which you're trying to paint a large area, but you only have a small brush. Your strokes are careful and calculated. You're doing a neat and precise job, but you're also doing things the hard way. Go easy on yourself and get a large brush. Make your strokes gigantic so you can cover more area with less effort.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Take initiative and boldly pursue greatness, dearest Taurus, as the Moon debuts in your sign. This cosmic shift boosts your charisma, and following your dreams will only make your light shine brighter. A revolutionary energy helps you shatter obstacles that once seemed formidable, thanks to a helping hand from transformative Pluto. If you are persistent and believe in yourself, people will respond to the power you project.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Do not allow the feeling of frustration overtake you. The economic side is likely to strengthen. If you had lent money to a person, you are expected to get that money back today. Friends and near ones would extend their helping hand upon you. Travel and educational pursuits will enhance your awareness. Your spouse might come under the adverse influence of others and fight with you, but your love and compassion will settle everything down. You might give way to foodie in you, and savor many delicacies. You may also visit a restaurant where exotic cuisine is served.

You are in a fantastic position to make your next major career move. Don't lose sight of this as being one of your major strong points.

Future-oriented thoughts and ideas are featured as you think about how to take them to a wider and more profitable market. Being stuck in a rut can be a very frustrating experience, as everything you try to do to extricate yourself from the situation only seems to make it worse! If you are feeling stuck, remember to immediately lower your expectations of yourself. This doesn't mean forget working out or forget your daily intake of water; it means don't expect yourself to do everything "right" all the time! Cut yourself the slack you need in order to catch up to your positive attitude.
